race.title: QuinnBet Handicap Chase
race.verdict: SCAIRP DUBH had excuses here last time so is well worth another chance to confirm the promise of his chase debut win over C&D in May. Drop Kick built up a solid record over hurdles and he's likely to make a chaser, so is feared most ahead of Kinbara Firstdraft and Halpha Soleil . SCAIRP DUBH DROP KICK (IRE) KINBARA FIRSTDRAFT (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Halpha Soleil (3/1), Kinbara Firstdraft (4/1), Scairp Dubh (13/2), Monochromix (7/1), Drop Kick (8/1), Yapper Hill (12/1), Dr Shirocco (14/1), Colonel Jack (14/1), Cowboy Cooper (14/1), Stretchemout (16/1), Order Another One (20/1), King Of Cong (25/1)
